title: **Gharibabadi: US Exits ‘Ineffective’ Human Rights Council That ‘Does Not Dare Ask Washington a Single Question’**
text:
**Gharibabadi: US Exits ‘Ineffective’ Human Rights Council That ‘Does Not Dare Ask Washington a Single Question’**"

"TEHRAN — Kazem Gharibabadi, Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs for Legal and International Affairs, said at a session on the annual reports of human rights violations in the United States and the United Kingdom that the US had recently withdrawn from the Human Rights Council, describing it as an ineffective body that does not dare ask the US a single question."

"“Recently, we also have the US withdrawal from the Human Rights Council,” Gharibabadi said."

"“The Human Rights Council—particularly during the two military aggressions against the Islamic Republic of Iran over the past year and a half, and the crimes committed by the Zionist regime in Gaza over nearly the past three years—has shown its nature: this council is neither effective nor does it have any belief in the Human Rights Council.”"

"“The US has withdrawn from this same ineffective council, of which nothing remains—a council that perhaps does not even dare to raise a question about the US or even adopt a resolution or decision regarding the US,” he added.
